q: The process of breaking down food into simple absorbable nutrients is called ____. (P4)
explain: Digestion begins in the mouth and continues through the stomach and intestines.
hint: Breaking down food in the body.

q: Digestion of starch begins in the ____ with saliva enzymes. (P4)
explain: Salivary amylase in the mouth begins digesting complex starches into simpler sugars.
hint: Where chewing and saliva mix with food.

q: The invisible downward pull that attracts all objects toward the center of the Earth is ____. (P4)
explain: Gravity gives objects weight and keeps planets in orbit.
hint: Force that makes dropped objects fall down.

q: The force that resists motion when two surfaces rub against each other is ____. (P4)
explain: Friction generates heat and opposes sliding motion between contacting surfaces.

q: Like magnetic poles (North and North, or South and South) ____ each other. (P4)
explain: Like poles push away (repel); unlike poles (North and South) attract.

q: The change of water from liquid state into water vapour gas is called ____. (P4)
explain: Evaporation occurs when liquid water molecules gain heat energy and become gas.

q: The change of water vapour gas into liquid water droplets is called ____. (P4)
explain: Condensation occurs when warm water vapour cools down on cool surfaces.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): What is the chemical formula of pure water?
explain: H₂O is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Which organ pumps blood in the human body?
explain: Heart is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Which gas do humans inhale for cellular respiration?
explain: Oxygen is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Which gas do green plants absorb during photosynthesis?
explain: Carbon dioxide is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): What is the freezing point of pure water at sea level?
explain: 0°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): What is the boiling point of pure water at standard atmospheric pressure?
explain: 100°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The female reproductive cell in humans and animals is the ____.
explain: ovum (egg) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The male reproductive cell in animals is the ____.
explain: sperm is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Animals that eat ONLY plants are called ____.
explain: herbivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Animals that eat ONLY meat and other animals are called ____.
explain: carnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Animals that eat BOTH plants and meat are called ____.
explain: omnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The largest organ of the human body is the ____.
explain: skin is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The framework of bones that supports and protects human organs is the ____.
explain: skeleton is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Sound cannot travel through a ____ because there are no particles to vibrate.
explain: vacuum (empty space) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Which energy is obtained directly from the sun?
explain: Solar energy is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
explain: Jupiter is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): Which planet is famous for its bright, prominent rings?
explain: Saturn is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The process by which seeds begin to sprout and grow into young seedlings is ____.
explain: germination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower is ____.
explain: pollination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The loss of water vapour from the leaves of plants through stomata is ____.
explain: transpiration is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The powerhouse organelle inside animal and plant cells that produces energy is the ____.
explain: mitochondrion is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The control center of a biological cell containing genetic DNA is the ____.
explain: nucleus is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The rigid outer protective layer found in plant cells but absent in animal cells is the ____.
explain: cell wall is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The force of attraction between any two masses in the universe is ____.
explain: gravitation is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P4): The measure of how much matter is packed into a given volume is called ____.
explain: density is the scientifically verified fact.
